reason: The batch-tested QR report and 200 mg bisglycinate with no oxide are what I look for, and with 20% off the first box it comes to about $24, close to what I already pay. The sachet is handy on work trips and for the gym bag, so I would try one box.
objection: I have never heard of this brand and there are no reviews yet. Full price is $29.99, more than Toplux or Goli, and I would only reorder at that price if the lab report really checks out.
